blogs.title: The Return of the LSTM: Introducing xLSTM
blogs.description: A high-level look at the evolution of language models. This post explores how the once-dominant LSTM was overtaken by Transformers, and how the new xLSTM architecture brings the best of both worlds to challenge the current state-of-the-art in Large Language Models (LLMs).

blogs.title: Scalar vs. Matrix Memory: How xLSTM Remembers Better
blogs.description: A deep dive into the technical innovations of xLSTM. This post explains the difference between sLSTM and mLSTM, focusing on how exponential gating and matrix memory allow the model to store more information and actually revise its storage decisions—something traditional LSTMs struggled with.

blogs.title: Breaking the Quadratic Barrier: xLSTM and the Future of Long Contexts
blogs.description: An exploration of the efficiency gains provided by xLSTM. This post explains the difference between the quadratic complexity of Transformers and the linear complexity of xLSTM, discussing what this means for faster text generation, higher throughput, and running powerful AI on edge devices.

blogs.title: Beyond Transformers: Can Recurrent Models Win the Scaling War?
blogs.description: An analysis of the research paper's experimental results. This post breaks down how xLSTM compares to Llama and Mamba in terms of perplexity and scaling laws, arguing why xLSTM is a serious competitor for the next generation of billion-parameter models.
